maps.points.rat_nest.detail: You enter the stone chamber, filled with overwhelming stench: urine, rotting flesh, and wet hair. The ground is covered in filth.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue: The stench hits you as you enter the chamber: urine, rotting flesh, and wet fur. The floor is covered in filth.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-11: You study the swarm with uneasy respect.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-12: "A colony has rules. This one has a queen. Ugly, yes... but efficient."
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-13: Choose “You have to watch this creature.”
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-14: You lean forward, eyes wide with captivated delight.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-15: "Look at her... absolute perfection in decay," you whisper.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-2: Dozens of rats scurry across the rubble, squeezing through cracks in the walls. Their squeals echo through the chamber.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-20: You step forward, squinting at the swollen matron with clear disgust.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-22: You crack your neck, ready your weapon, and roar.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-23: Choose “Take a headshot at the Queen.”
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-24: You draw your bow and take aim at the Queen.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-25: You release the arrow, aiming straight for her head.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-26: But at the last heartbeat, a rat launches itself into the arrow's path, taking the shot straight through its body.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-27: It crumples at her feet, and the Queen shrieks so loudly you feel the pain in your skull.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-3: Something shifts among the rats at the far end of the chamber.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-4: Bloated and scarred - the Rat Queen.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-5: The smaller rats retreat, clearing a space around their queen. Her tail lashes against the floor as she slowly rises.
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-6: You have to watch this creature. (Requires Raven)
maps.points.rat_nest.dialogue-8: Take a headshot at the Queen. (Requires Ranger)
maps.points.rat_nest.f21.detail: Press the sensor at (39, -48), to progress the dialogue to the start of the battle in the "Rat Nest Leader" event.
maps.points.rat_nest.f32.detail: The "Rat Nest Leader Encounter" refers to this individual, but the checkpoint information does not specify its appearance conditions.

maps.points.rat_nest.l03.detail: Broken Bone ×2, Bone, Potion of Minor Healing
maps.points.rat_nest.l04.detail: Golden Coins, Lockpick Tools, Potion of Minor Healing, Rusty Sword
maps.points.rat_nest.l08.detail: Amulet of Freezing, Potion of Stamina, Potion of Minor Healing ×2, Potion of Cure Poison
maps.points.rat_nest.l09.detail: Golden Coins ×3, Rat Ration, Potion of Minor Stamina
maps.points.rat_nest.l10.detail: Barlo's Doll, Dust and Bones, Bone, Golden Coins ×4, Moldy Bread, Cheese, Potion of Minor Mana, Scale Helmet
maps.points.rat_nest.n01.detail: Although the path is blocked, dozens of rat tracks are visible on the floor, reaching where you can't.
maps.points.rat_nest.n02.detail: The air is noticeably warmer, and you can catch the sweet smell of... something indescribable. And it's not pleasant.
maps.points.rat_nest.title: Encounter of the Rat Nest Leader
